chars.G: GHIZLANE: a tall slim young woman wearing a lilac oversized hoodie, white wide-leg jeans, white chunky sneakers and small gold hoop earrings.
chars.H: HAJ: a plump older man with a thick grey moustache, wearing a navy blazer over a white shirt, beige trousers and a big shiny gold watch.
chars.S: SALMA: a young woman wearing a black leather jacket, a red top, black skinny jeans and black ankle boots.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny seaside street in Martil, Morocco, HAJ leans out of the window of a shiny black luxury car, eagerly holding out a fan of banknotes and a phone toward GHIZLANE, who stands on the sidewalk with arms crossed and one eyebrow raised, unimpressed and cheeky. Comic awkward moment, palm trees and white houses behind.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Moroccan cafe, GHIZLANE sits confidently like a teacher explaining a plan with one finger raised, while SALMA listens with wide surprised eyes and laughs behind her hand. Mint tea glasses on the table.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At a cafe terrace table, GHIZLANE smugly counts a thick stack of banknotes, while HAJ sitting across the table sweats nervously and wipes his forehead with a handkerchief, glancing around afraid someone will see him.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: GHIZLANE walks proudly along the Martil corniche promenade by the sea; in the background several older men in suits on benches turn their heads to stare at her with dropped jaws. Funny scene.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a girl's bedroom, SALMA holds a measuring tape up against a wall next to GHIZLANE who stands very tall and proud on tiptoes, SALMA looking up at her amazed. Bright cheerful room.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: GHIZLANE sits at a vanity mirror with lights around it, putting on lipstick and checking her reflection with a confident grown-up pose, makeup and perfume bottles on the table.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: On a busy Moroccan street at evening, HAJ suddenly blocks GHIZLANE's way, holding his phone out with a hopeful pleading smile, asking for her number; GHIZLANE stops, surprised, hands on hips. Shops and street lamps behind.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: GHIZLANE holds out her open palm toward HAJ with a sly cheeky smile, demanding payment first; HAJ freezes with shocked wide eyes, his phone in one hand and his wallet half out in the other. Moroccan street at evening, comic tension.
